different.question: What makes HypnoSleep different from other hypnosis apps?
different.answer: HypnoSleep writes a fresh hypnosis script for the goal you describe — every session, every time. Pick a voice and a length, and you have a personalised audio in about 30 seconds.

works.question: Does AI hypnosis actually work?
works.answer: Hypnosis is essentially focused attention plus suggestion. The AI writes the script following the structured pattern that clinical hypnotherapists use — induction, deepening, suggestion, emergence — and a calm voice reads it to you.

safe.question: Is it safe?
safe.answer: Yes. Listen in a quiet place where you can rest safely. Do not listen while driving or operating machinery. If you have a history of psychosis, seizures, or PTSD, talk to a qualified clinician before using any hypnosis product.

speed.question: How long does session generation take?
speed.answer: Usually 30 to 60 seconds end to end: a few seconds to write the script, the rest for voice synthesis.

cancel.question: Can I cancel anytime?
cancel.answer: Yes. One tap in Settings → Subscription. Your Pro benefits stay active until the end of the billing period, no questions asked.

refund.question: Do you offer refunds?
refund.answer: If the app did not work for you, email us within 30 days of your first Pro charge and we will look at your case. We are a small team and we want you happy.

privacy.question: Is my data private?
privacy.answer: Your goals, scripts, and listening history are encrypted and tied only to your account. We never sell data, we never train third-party models on your content, and you can export or delete everything with one tap.

languages.question: What languages are supported?
languages.answer: Sessions are generated in English at launch. The app interface is available in English, French, Portuguese, Spanish, German and Italian. More session languages will follow once we can ship them properly.
